office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes in Grant County, represents the county in civil cases, and advises county officials and school boards.
race_blurb: Uncontested: appointed Prosecuting Attorney Brandon K. Guernsey (Prefers Republican Party), in office since August 2025, is the only candidate for the short and full term.

candidates.summary: Appointed Grant County Prosecuting Attorney since August 2025 and a Grant County deputy prosecutor from 2017 to early 2025; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed prosecutor by the county commissioners in July 2025 and sworn in August 4, 2025 [S2]
Grant County deputy prosecutor from 2017, including major drug cases from the Interagency Narcotics Enforcement Team [S2]
Says his priorities are office culture, victim support, supporting law enforcement and modernizing the office [S1]
